name: AI-Agent-Human-in-the-Loop
title: AI Agent Human-in-the-Loop Template
summary: Requires a human-only verification step, such as a passkey, when an AI agent that identifies itself with Web Bot Auth signs in.
preRequisites: Modify the 1st and 2nd factor authentication option(s) from defaults as required.
AI agents are identified by their Web Bot Auth headers (Signature, Signature-Input and Signature-Agent). Make sure your load balancers and proxies forward them to the server.
To identify AI agents that do not use Web Bot Auth, extend detectAgent(). See the documentation for examples.
The 2nd step must be one that only a human can complete, such as a passkey or a push notification. Do not enable progressive enrollment for it in this flow, so an agent cannot enroll its own device.
